_note: Devstral Small 2 (24B, Mistral-Small-3.1 base, FP8-quantized ~24 GB -> fits one GPU). Agentic coding model, 256k context, vision-capable base. Card-reported SWE-bench Verified 68.0%.
_note_serve: Model card: vllm serve mistralai/Devstral-Small-2-24B-Instruct-2512 --max-model-len 262144 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --tool-call-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice. Unlike Devstral-Small-2505 (mistral-format-only), this ships BOTH HF (tokenizer.json + chat_template.jinja) and tekken.json, so it serves in STANDARD HF mode (no --tokenizer-mode mistral). Tool calling = --tool-call-parser mistral; the wrong parser silently zeroes the eval (memory: vllm-tool-parser-gotcha). Requires mistral_common >= 1.8.6 in the serve image.
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) EQUALS the model's native 256k context (262144). Pass MAX_MODEL_LEN=262144 in the qsub env to force it over the sbatch's 131072 default. At 262144 context on 24B-BFP8, TP=2 is the card's recommendation; a single H100 with enough memory can run it but a long window needs the 2-GPU split.
